_comment: Captions for the shortform-explainer format: 1080x1920, graphics in the TOP half, speaker in the BOTTOM half, and these captions in the MIDDLE band straddling the seam between them. The band is the whole point - it gives the seam a job instead of leaving a visible join, and it sits above TikTok's action rail, which only starts around y=55 %.
_usage: vedit/captions.py: build_ass(words, project, preset). Values under 'ass_style' are ASS field names and go straight through. Keys beginning with '_' are documentation and MUST be ignored.
name: shortform-highlight
_comment_play_res: PlayResX/PlayResY MUST equal the render resolution, or every px value below is scaled by libass and the width budget stops meaning pixels.

font._comment: Static ExtraBold file, not a variable font. ASS cannot select a weight axis, so a variable Inter would render Regular plus faux-bold no matter what the style says - and it would do it silently, exit 0.
font._comment_bold: Bold=0. The weight comes from the file; asking for Bold=-1 on top would be faux-bold over a real 800.

ass_style._comment: Colours are ASS &HAABBGGRR - reversed byte order, alpha 00 = fully opaque. BackColour is a 60 %-opaque black plate used only if BorderStyle is switched to 3.
ass_style.Name: Default

_comment_alignment: Alignment 5 = middle centre. With Alignment 5 libass mostly ignores MarginV, so the band position below is authoritative and build_ass must emit an explicit \pos.

position._comment: The caption band is centred on the 50 % seam between the graphics half and the speaker half. Emit \pos(centre_x_px, centre_y_px) computed from play_res, so the block grows symmetrically about the seam as lines are added.

grouping._comment: PIXEL-width budget, never max_chars: German compound nouns are single unsplittable tokens that blow any character cap. Short cards, because the band is read in peripheral vision while the graphic above it carries the argument.

_comment_width_vs_safe_area: 900 px is wider than platforms.tiktok.safe_area_pct would allow (that inset reserves 20 % on the right for the action rail). It is safe HERE only because the band sits at 43-57 % height, above where the rail begins. A caption placed at the bottom of a 9:16 frame must use the platform inset - see tiktok-bold.

overflow._comment: At 64 px in Inter ExtraBold a 26-character compound noun runs past 900 px, so this path fires on real German material, not just in theory.

highlight._comment: Per-word highlight, implemented as one Dialogue event per word rather than \k karaoke. \k needs the whole line as a single event and quantises to centiseconds, so a highlight lands up to 5 ms off the frame it belongs to; separate events snap to exact frame boundaries and survive being re-timed by a later cut.
highlight._comment_scale: A 6 % bump is enough to read as emphasis. More than about 110 % reflows the line and makes the block twitch.

safe_area._comment: The vertical formats default to the TikTok safe area because it is the most restrictive of the three vertical platforms; anything laid out for it is safe on Reels and Shorts.

_comment_punctuation: Trailing full stops are dropped: on a two-word card they read as a pause that the audio does not contain. Question marks and exclamation marks are kept - they change the reading.
